question: Who is the author of the book "Homeopathy for Anemia", which highlights homeopathy's success in treating aplastic anemia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. AK Dwivedi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Dr. AK Dwivedi, a senior homeopathic physician, presented his book *Homeopathy for Anemia* to Madhya Pradesh CM Dr. Mohan Yadav in Indore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The event showcased the book's focus on homeopathic treatments for **aplastic anemia**, a severe condition often deemed more critical than cancer.
 
• Dr. Dwivedi is a member of the **Executive Council at Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, the Board of Studies for Homeopathy at MP Medical Science University, and the Central Homeopathy Research Council under AYUSH.**
 
• Chief Minister Dr. Mohan Yadav praised the book as a **valuable resource for healthcare professionals** and commended Dr. Dwivedi's contributions to homeopathy.
 
• Dr. Dwivedi emphasized the effectiveness of **50 millesimal potency medicines**, addressing misconceptions about homeopathy being slow-acting.
 
• He highlighted homeopathy's role during COVID-19, citing the use of **Arsenic Album** to boost immunity and combat the virus, reshaping global perceptions of homeopathy.
 
• Patient testimonials of **aplastic anemia cures** are available on Dr. Dwivedi's YouTube channel, showcasing successful recoveries without ongoing medication.
 
• The book includes practical advice for improving hemoglobin levels through dietary changes, emphasizing **Indian food items**.
